name: The Departure of the Orient Express
description: The gleaming Orient Express pulls away from the station, its wheels turning smoothly as it begins its journey down the track, leaving the platform behind amidst a quiet hush of steam and motion.
related_events: Orient Express departs from the station

name: Cara Leads Frank Into the Hotel Room Kissing
description: Still kissing, Cara steps backward, guiding Frank with her as she moves from the doorway into the hotel room. Her hands remain on him as she leads the way, the kiss uninterrupted while they cross the threshold and enter the room together.
related_events: Cara leads Frank back into the hotel room while kissing

name: Cara Waits on the Platform
description: Cara stands alone on the platform as the station buzzes with activity around her. The train, sleek and polished, rests behind her on the tracks. She remains still, waiting, as people move past in all directions.
related_events: Cara waits on the platform at the busy station

name: Frank and Cara Share a Romantic Dinner on the Orient Express
description: The Orient Express moves through the snowy peaks of the Alps. Inside, Frank and Cara sit across from each other at a small table set with a flickering candle, crystal glasses, and a linen tablecloth. They eat quietly, exchanging glances and soft words as the train carries them forward through the mountain night.
related_events: Frank and Cara share a romantic dinner on the Orient Express
Orient Express travels through the Alps

name: Frank Searches for Cara on the Airplane
description: Frank moves down the aisle of the airplane, brushing against passengers as he goes. He stumbles slightly with each step, murmuring apologies, his eyes scanning the rows ahead. He continues forward, looking from seat to seat, checking each face as he passes.
related_events: Frank navigates through airplane cabin searching for Cara

name: Convoy Arrives at Prefecture de Police
description: A convoy of black Mercedes drives across the bridge and pulls up to the entrance of the Prefecture de Police on the Ile de la Cité. The vehicles come to a stop, their engines quieting in the stillness of the morning air.
related_events: Convoy of black Mercedes arrives at Prefecture de Police

name: Frank and Cara Enter the Hotel
description: Frank and Cara follow the porter into the hotel's central hall. They walk across the marble floor beneath a soaring ornate staircase that rises past Gothic galleries and intricately carved balustrades. Frank looks around, his expression filled with wonder as he takes in the grandeur of the space.
related_events: Frank and Cara follow the porter into the hotel's central hall
Frank expresses amazement at the hotel's interior

name: Cara and Frank Enter the Hotel Room
description: Cara and Frank step across the threshold into the hotel room. The door swings shut behind them, cutting off the outside view as their silhouettes fade into the dim interior.
related_events: Cara and Frank enter the hotel room

name: Nurse Assists Frank into MRI Scanner
description: Frank lies flat on his back as a nurse leans over him with a kindly expression. She reassures him, then slowly slides him head first into the MRI machine. The scanner hums to life as he moves into the tunnel.
related_events: Nurse prepares Frank for MRI scan
MRI machine activates as Frank enters scanning tunnel

name: Arrival on a Cobbled Street in Paris
description: A taxi pulls up to the curb on a wide, cobbled street in Paris. The door opens, and a woman steps out, her feet clad in red-soled Christian Louboutin high heels. She stands on the pavement as the city hums around her, cars passing and people moving along the misty street.
related_events: Taxi arrives at curb on cobbled street in Paris
Female passenger exits taxi in high heels

name: Ackerman and the Interpol Tactics Team Land on Misty Beach
description: A patrol boat emerges from the fog and glides silently toward the shore. It touches the beach gently, and a ramp lowers. The Interpol Tactics Team, clad in Kevlar and headgear, steps out onto the sand. Ackerman follows, pulling on his tactical vest. He nods to Goyal, then moves forward with the team into the mist.
related_events: Ackerman arrives on shore and prepares for operation
Interpol Tactics Team disembarks from patrol boat onto beach

name: Cara Mason Walks Through the Train Station
description: Cara Mason ascends the steps into the train station, crosses the concourse, and moves through the terminal. Men turn to look at her as she passes, but she shows no reaction. Wearing dark glasses, she carries a traveling bag in one hand and a copy of the International Herald Tribune in the other, continuing steadily forward without pause.
related_events: Cara Mason walks through train station while men stare

name: Ivan Demidov Arrives in Venice with Bodyguards
description: A Gulfstream G550 executive jet descends over the Venetian coast and lands smoothly. The aircraft comes to a stop, wheels still warm from the runway. The stairway lowers and unfolds to the tarmac. Ivan Demidov steps out, wearing a hand-tailored Italian suit and expensive leather shoes. Two bodyguards follow closely behind him as he walks away from the plane.
related_events: Gulfstream G550 executive jet lands on the Venetian coast
Ivan Demidov disembarks from a Gulfstream G550 executive jet in Venice

name: Frank Flees Down Stairs and Escapes Through Side Door
description: Frank ran down the staircase three steps at a time, his feet slamming against the metal treads. Behind him, his pursuers thundered down the stairs faster, closing the distance. Gunfire cracked as they shot through the railing; bullets snapped and ricocheted off the walls and steps, pinging like pinballs in the narrow space. Frank gasped for breath, his legs burning, but kept driving forward. He reached a side door, threw his weight against it, and burst through, disappearing outside.
related_events: Frank flees down the stairs while being pursued
Pursuers fire bullets through the stairwell railing
Frank escapes through a side door

name: Frank Flees After a Gunshot in the Hotel Room
description: Frank bursts out of the hotel room just after a gunshot rings out behind him. He dashes past the Welshman's wife, reaches the corridor, and sprints down the hall, narrowly passing a room service steward pushing a cart.
related_events: Gunshot fired in the hotel room
Frank runs from the hotel room after a gunshot
Frank passes a room service steward in the corridor

name: Cara and Frank on the Danieli Launch
description: The Danieli launch speeds across the Grand Canal, passing magnificent palaces and churches that rise along the water's edge. Cara stands on the boat, shaking her head as the wind catches her hair. Beside her, Frank grips the railing tightly, his body tense against the motion of the vessel.
related_events: Launch labelled Danieli travels fast over the Grand Canal
Cara lets the wind ruffle her hair
Frank clutches the railing in fear

name: Frank Wakes to the Train Stopped and Gathers His Things
description: Frank's eyes open. He looks out the window and sees the train is no longer moving. A voice comes over the loudspeaker, speaking in Italian. Frank sits up quickly, fumbles for his book, pulls on his sweater, grabs a bottle of pills, and begins collecting his belongings.
related_events: Frank wakes up and notices the train has stopped
Conductor announces information over the loudspeaker in Italian
Frank gathers his belongings in a hurry

name: The Specialist Bypasses the Biometric Lock
description: The Specialist kneels in front of an electric panel and places his hand against a glass plate with a fingertip outline in the center. A red light flashes and a beep sounds as the system registers his fingerprint. He turns to Ackerman and says, 'This is gonna take a few minutes.' Ackerman nods in response. The Specialist opens a tool box containing sophisticated equipment and begins working on the panel.
related_events: Specialist activates biometric lock using fingerprint
Specialist informs Ackerman of delay
Ackerman acknowledges Specialist's timeline without protest
Specialist prepares tools for security system bypass

name: Ackerman and Jones Pursue Suspect to Venice
description: Footsteps echo through the grand marble hallways as John Ackerman, British chief inspector with Interpol, strides forward with purpose. Melissa Jones, his American counterpart, matches his pace. 'We're putting a lot of resources into this investigation, John,' she says. 'Tell me you're going to get him this time.' Ackerman replies without hesitation, 'We're going to get him this time, Ms. Jones.' Goyal, Ackerman's deputy, snaps his cell phone shut. 'She's on the train,' he says. 'They'll be in Venice in the morning.'
related_events: John Ackerman and Melissa Jones walk through the grand marble hallway
Melissa Jones expresses concern about investigation resources
John Ackerman assures Melissa Jones of suspect apprehension
Goyal receives a phone update about the suspect on the train

name: Cara and Frank's Kiss by the Lagoon
description: Frank joins Cara as she looks out across the lagoon. She turns to him suddenly, presses her body against his, and kisses him passionately. He responds, wrapping his arms around her back. Below, on the Ponte del Vin, a small video camera protrudes from behind a vendor's cart, its lens focused on them. The whirring of the device fills the air as it records the moment.
related_events: Frank appears beside Cara at the lagoon
Cara notices movement on the Ponte del Vin
Cara presses her body against Frank and initiates a kiss
Hidden video camera records Frank and Cara kissing

name: The Porter Shows the Apartment
description: Under a gilded and coffered ceiling, portraits of the Doges line the walls as the porter guides the visitors through the large apartment. He opens and closes doors, leading them from room to room. He shows the bedroom, points out two bathrooms, and gestures toward a small kitchen. Noting Cara’s demeanor, he adds that she may not need it. He lists the amenities—two televisions, video, DVD, radio, and a hi-fi sound system. Then, with a flourish, he throws open a pair of French windows. The expanse of St. Mark's Basin and the Venetian lagoon unfolds below. The visitors step forward, taking in the view. The porter asks if everything is satisfactory. Cara replies that it is and thanks him. He turns to the man, waiting, but receives no tip. Cara takes a few Euros from her purse and hands them to him. The porter leaves.
related_events: Porter gives tour of the apartment to visitors
Porter comments on Cara's perceived lack of interest in cooking
Porter opens French windows to reveal view of St. Mark's Basin and Venetian lagoon

name: Cara Tips the Porter
description: The tour ended with the porter standing near the door, glancing at Frank. When Frank did not respond, Cara took a few Euros from her purse and handed them to the porter. He accepted them and left the apartment.
related_events: Cara tips the Porter after he expects gratuity from Frank

name: Frank Escapes Through the Leather Shop to the Canal Alley
description: Frank ducks into a leather shop, moving quickly to the back. He finds the exit and pushes through, stepping onto cobblestones beside the Grand Canal. Blood runs from his forehead and hand. The alley stretches out before him, narrow and long, with an awning overhead and clear sight lines in both directions.
related_events: Frank enters leather shop and locates back entrance
Leather shop's back entrance opens onto Grand Canal

name: Frank Bleeding in Alley Decides Escape Route
description: Frank ducks into a leather shop and rushes to the back entrance, stepping onto cobblestones in a narrow alley. Blood streams from a wound on his forehead and from his hand. An awning stretches overhead, and the alley extends in both directions with clear sight lines. The back of the shop opens near the Grand Canal. He stands still for a moment, then quickly looks left and right, deciding which way to go.
related_events: Frank sustains head and hand injuries with blood streaming
Frank pauses to decide escape direction in narrow alley

name: Frank Joins Cara on the Balcony
description: Cara relaxes as she hears Frank approaching. He steps outside onto the balcony and tells her he has put his things in the other bathroom. She turns to face him.
related_events: Frank steps onto the balcony to join Cara
Frank informs Cara he has stored his belongings in the other bathroom

name: Cara and Frank Plan a Night Out in Venice
description: Cara turns to Frank and asks if he has ever been to Venice before. Frank shakes his head, indicating he hasn't. She looks at him and says they need to go out.
related_events: Cara asks Frank if he has visited Venice before
Frank declines with a head shake indicating no prior visit to Venice

name: Frank Checks the Door and Lets the Porter In
description: Frank walks to the door and looks through the spyhole. The porter stands on the other side with a trolley. Frank opens the door, and the porter wheels the trolley inside, beginning to carry the bags into the bedroom.

Frank looks through the spyhole
Frank opens the door

name: Porter Delivers Luggage to Bedroom
description: Frank walks to the door and looks through the spyhole. The porter stands outside with a trolley. Frank opens the door. The porter wheels the trolley into the room and begins carrying the bags into the bedroom.
related_events: Porter wheels trolley into the room
Porter carries bags into the bedroom

name: Frank Finds the Engraving on Cara's Watch
description: Frank takes off the watch Cara gave him and turns it over, noticing an engraving on the back that reads 'ALEXANDER PEARCE'. He stares at the name for a moment, then walks to his travel bag, unzips it, and takes out a bottle of pills. He swallows several, then brushes his teeth. Standing in front of the mirror, he pauses and looks at his reflection without moving. After a moment, he sets the toothbrush down and walks to the sofa, where he lies down to sleep.
related_events: Frank notices engraving on watch given by Cara
Frank takes pills from his travel bag

name: Frank's Nighttime Routine and Mirror Pause
description: Frank takes off the watch Cara gave him and notices an engraving on the back: ALEXANDER PEARCE. He unzips his travel bag, takes out his pills, and swallows several. He wets his toothbrush and brushes his teeth. Midway, he stops, looking at his reflection in the mirror. He stands still, studying his face. After a moment, he sets the toothbrush down and walks to the sofa, where he lies down and goes to sleep.

Frank goes to sleep on the sofa

name: Frank and Cara Arrive at the Apartment
description: Frank and Cara stumble through the front door, laughing, a little unsteady on their feet. Cara lets her wrap fall onto a chair and kicks her shoes off, then walks over to the French doors and swings them open to the balcony. Frank starts toward the living room, glances at the sofa, and pauses. His expression changes. Without a word, he turns and follows her outside.
related_events: Frank and Cara enter the apartment laughing and slightly intoxicated
Cara removes her wrap and kicks off her shoes
Frank becomes sobered by the sight of the sofa

Frank follows Cara onto the balcony

name: Ackerman Directs Surveillance After Goyal's Report
description: Goyal moves through the crowded operations room, weaving past personnel and equipment from multiple national agencies, and reports that the target has checked into the Danieli hotel and is not alone. Ackerman, standing calm amidst the activity, relays orders to the team: maintain surveillance but keep a safe distance. He warns everyone not to attempt clever tactics, reminding them that Pearce is smarter than most of them combined. Quinn listens quietly, then slips out of the room unnoticed.
related_events: Goyal reports that the target has checked into the Danieli hotel with another person
Ackerman orders the team to maintain surveillance while keeping a safe distance
Ackerman warns the team not to attempt clever tactics against Pearce

name: Quinn Leaves the Briefing
description: As the surveillance briefing continues, Quinn quietly slips out of the operations room and moves away from the group, leaving without drawing attention.
related_events: Quinn quietly exits the operations room

name: Frank Arrives and Finds Cara at the Station
description: Frank steps off the train and looks around at the bustling station. He moves through the crowd, passing the Good-Looking Englishman from Paris without stopping. Ahead, he sees Cara with her back turned. He hurries to her. I was afraid I'd missed you, he says. I wanted to ask where you're staying in Venice... I'm supposed to catch a shuttle to my hotel but I thought maybe— She holds out her valise without turning. He takes it hesitantly. She peers at him over the rims of her sunglasses, a faint smile on her lips.
related_events: Frank steps off the train and observes the station activity
Frank brushes past the Good-Looking Englishman
Frank approaches Cara at the station

name: Frank Reunites with Cara and Takes Her Valise
description: Frank steps off the train and scans the bustling station until he sees Cara, her back turned. He approaches quickly. 'I was afraid I'd missed you,' he says. 'I wanted to ask where you're staying in Venice... I'm supposed to catch a shuttle to my hotel but I thought maybe--' 'I've got a better idea,' Cara interrupts, still not turning. She holds out her valise. Frank hesitates, then takes it. She tilts her head slightly, peering at him over the rims of her sunglasses with a faint smile.
related_events: Frank expresses concern about missing Cara and inquires about her hotel
Cara proposes an alternative plan and hands Frank her valise
Cara looks at Frank over her sunglasses with a subtle smile

name: Frank Awakens to a Waiter Preparing Breakfast
description: Frank jolts awake at the sound of a loud clang. A waiter is in the room, quietly arranging a breakfast cart. Frank sits up, blinking in surprise as he takes in the spread of food. The waiter moves with deliberate care, placing items on the tray without speaking. Frank looks around the suite, noticing he is alone.
related_events: Frank wakes up startled by a sudden noise
Waiter sets up breakfast on a cart in Frank's suite

name: Frank Awakens to Breakfast Left by a Woman
description: Frank wakes suddenly as a waiter clangs a tray while setting up a breakfast cart. The waiter apologizes and greets him with a good morning, explaining that the woman—'La Signora'—ordered the meal before she left. Frank looks around the suite, realizing he is alone. He nods slowly, thanks the waiter, and sits up as the waiter departs after receiving a one Euro tip.
related_events: Waiter informs Frank that a woman ordered breakfast for him
Frank realizes he is alone in the suite

name: Frank Tips the Waiter and Sits Up
description: The waiter finished arranging the breakfast cart and stood still for a moment, looking at Frank. Frank reached out and handed him a one Euro coin. The waiter took it, his expression sour, then turned and left the room. Frank threw off the blanket, swung his legs over the side of the bed, and sat up.
related_events: Frank gives the waiter a one Euro tip

Frank sits up after throwing off the blanket

name: Cara and Frank's Beach Walk in Venice
description: Cara and Frank walk side by side on a quiet stretch of beach in Venice. The winter sun shines brightly over the dark green sea, and sandbanks extend into the water. The wind lifts Cara’s light sun dress, pressing it against her body as she moves. Frank tells her he teaches high school math in Rosemont, Pennsylvania. When she asks what he does, he gives the same question back to her. She looks at him over her sunglasses, smiling slightly, and says, 'This is what I do, Frank.' He nods and says, 'You're good at it.'
related_events: Cara and Frank walk on a deserted beach in Venice
Frank reveals he is a high school math teacher
Cara responds to Frank's question about her occupation

name: Cara and Frank at the Beach Wedding
description: Cara and Frank walk along a quiet stretch of beach when the sound of laughter and voices reaches them. Ahead, a group of Italians in formal clothes gathers near the water, a woman in a white bridal dress among them. Cara smiles and points toward the scene. 'Oh look... a wedding. How lovely.' Frank watches for a moment and replies, 'I'm not really into weddings at this particular moment in my life...' Cara glances at him, then takes his arm and gently steers him away, leading him toward a bistro with tables set out on the sidewalk.
related_events: Cara and Frank notice a wedding ceremony on the beach
Frank expresses disinterest in weddings
Cara acknowledges Frank's sentiment and guides him toward a bistro

name: Frank steals a vendor's bicycle while fleeing along the canal
description: Frank sprints along the edge of the canal, weaving through tourists, children, vendors, and locals. He spots a vendor's three-wheel bicycle, jumps on it, and begins pedaling quickly. The bicycle moves too slowly, and Frank abruptly jumps off, losing his balance and falling hard. He cuts his hand in the fall but pushes himself up and keeps running. He climbs a set of hidden stairs and reaches the roof of a shop on the Riva Degli Schiavoni as the Russians close in behind him.
related_events: Frank sprints along the canal edge dodging pedestrians
Frank commandeers a vendor's three-wheel bicycle

name: Frank Abandons Bicycle and Flees on Foot After Fall
description: Frank sprinted along the edge of the canal, weaving through tourists, children, and vendors. He spotted a vendor's three-wheel bicycle and leapt onto it, pedaling hard. After a few moments, he realized the bicycle was too slow. He jumped off while still moving, lost his balance, and fell hard, cutting his hand. He scrambled to his feet despite the pain and ran up a set of hidden stairs, reaching the roof of a shop on the Riva Degli Schiavoni as the Russians closed in behind him.
related_events: Frank jumps off the bicycle after realizing it is too slow
Frank falls and cuts his hand during a spill
Frank climbs to his feet despite injury as Russians approach

name: Frank Reaches Rooftop via Hidden Stairs
description: After getting back on his feet, Frank runs up a narrow set of hidden stairs. He emerges onto the roof of a shop along the Riva Degli Schiavoni, moving quickly as the Russians close in.
related_events: Frank runs up hidden stairs to reach a rooftop

name: Frank's Fall from the Roof Ridge
description: Frank runs along the ridge of the roof. A silenced shot strikes a tile near him, causing him to lose balance. He tumbles down the sloping side of the roof, bouncing until he reaches the edge. As he falls, he reaches for the gutter, his hand slamming against it and his head striking the wall. He drops onto the pavement beside the small canal and quickly gets up, doubling back toward the lagoon. Behind him, the men continue their pursuit. He enters the Campo San Zaccaria, sending a flock of pigeons flapping into the air. Gondoliers and their passengers watch as he runs past, some shouting encouragement in Italian. The Russians push through the crowd, closing in fast.
related_events: Frank runs down the roof ridge and is nearly hit by a silenced shot
Frank falls from the roof and crashes into the gutter

name: Frank Flees Along the Canal
description: Frank lands hard on the pavement beside the canal, then scrambles to his feet and runs back toward the lagoon. He moves quickly despite the fall, his path taking him past the edge of the water as he continues to evade the men chasing him.
related_events: Frank lands on the pavement and retreats toward the lagoon

name: Frank Runs Through Campo San Zaccaria and Scatters Pigeons
description: Frank bursts into the crowded square of Campo San Zaccaria. He dashes across the open space, scattering a flock of pigeons that flap and flutter into the air. Pedestrians turn to look as he races past, his flight drawing stares and shouts from onlookers.
related_events: Frank enters Campo San Zaccaria and scatters pigeons

name: Gondoliers Cheer as Frank Flees
description: Frank runs past the gondolas along the canal, his body bare and movements frantic. The gondoliers and their passengers turn to watch, then break into cheers, calling out to him as he rushes by. Their voices rise in excitement, adding to the clamor of the chase.
related_events: Gondolieri and passengers observe and cheer for Frank

name: Russians Push Through Crowd in Pursuit
description: Frank stumbles into the Campo San Zaccaria, scattering a flock of pigeons as he runs. Behind him, the Russian men shove through the crowd, knocking pedestrians aside as they close the distance. Onlookers react with shouts and confusion as the chase races past gondolas and canal-side pathways. The pursuers reach for Frank, nearly grabbing him as he veers away.
related_events: Russians push through pedestrians in pursuit of Frank

name: Cara Ends the Intimacy
description: Cara closes the curtains and pulls away from Frank. Her expression shifts, the passion gone, replaced by a calm detachment. She tells him he should leave Venice the next day, saying the city is for lovers, not for recovering from a failed engagement. Frank asks what he did wrong. She replies that he did nothing, apologizes, and walks toward her bedroom. The door closes behind her with a soft click of the lock. Frank stands still, then sits on the sofa. Two folded blankets and a pillow rest there. From inside the bedroom, her muffled voice can be heard saying, '...that's exactly what I'm doing, but now I want him to go...' Frank moves toward the door, trying to hear more, but her words fade out.
related_events: Cara closes the curtains and withdraws from Frank

name: Cara Tells Frank to Leave
description: Cara closes the curtains and pulls away from Frank, her expression shifting to one of quiet resolve. She tells him he should leave Venice tomorrow, saying the city is meant for lovers, not for recovering from a broken engagement. Frank looks at her, stunned, asking what he did wrong. Cara replies that he did nothing, and that she’s sorry. She turns and walks toward her bedroom. The door closes behind her, and the sound of the lock clicking echoes through the room. Frank stands alone, then slowly sits on the sofa. From inside the bedroom, her muffled voice can be heard, but the words fade before they can be fully understood.
related_events: Cara advises Frank to leave Venice
Cara walks to her bedroom and locks the door

name: Frank Asks What Went Wrong
description: Frank stands still, visibly stunned as Cara pulls away and tells him to leave Venice, saying it's a city for lovers, not for recovering from a failed engagement. He asks, 'What... what did I do?' His voice carries confusion and hurt. Cara pauses at her bedroom door, her expression softening slightly. 'Nothing,' she says quietly. 'I'm sorry.' Then she steps inside and closes the door. The lock clicks behind her.
related_events: Frank expresses confusion and hurt
Cara apologizes and softens her expression

name: Frank Listens at the Bedroom Door
description: Frank stands alone in the dim room, then walks to the sofa and sits down. After a moment, he gets up and moves toward Cara's bedroom door. From inside, Cara's voice is faint but audible. He stops at the door, listening closely, trying to catch her words as they come through, muffled and indistinct. The sound of her speaking continues for a short while, then fades into silence.
related_events: Frank sits on the sofa after standing alone
Frank approaches the bedroom door to listen
Cara speaks from her bedroom, expressing her desire for Frank to leave

name: Frank's Confession Over Dinner
description: In the dining car of the Orient Express, Frank takes several pills from different bottles and swallows them one by one. Cara watches, then asks if he is ill. He says no, only nervous about traveling. She teases him for choosing the Orient Express if he dislikes journeys. He hesitates, then tells her he is on his honeymoon. She reacts with surprise and sarcasm, asking if they should set another place at the table. He explains his wife left him two weeks earlier for the owner of a pizza parlor. He had no travel insurance and couldn’t get a refund, so he came alone. Cara offers sympathy. Frank adds that he really liked the pizza too. The waiter arrives with their drinks—a Cointreau for Cara, a Miller Light for Frank. The waiter gives a disapproving look and leaves. Cara, amused, asks what brings him to Venice. Instead, she points to his worn spy novel and playfully challenges him to guess her story. He suggests she might be a diplomatic attaché or a woman from East Germany caught in a plot involving a stolen microchip. She asks what awaits her. He says trouble and danger, likely to be shot at soon. She asks if there’s a man in her life. He looks at her, then says, maybe.
related_events: Frank consumes multiple pills at the dining table
Cara questions Frank about his health and travel plans
Frank reveals his wife left him before their honeymoon

name: Drinks Served on the Orient Express
description: The waiter arrives at the table with a Cointreau for Cara and a Miller Light for Frank. He sets the drinks down, glancing at Frank with a faint look of disapproval before rolling his eyes and walking away. Cara watches the exchange, a small smile playing on her lips. Frank takes his beer without noticing. The mood at the table shifts, the earlier heaviness giving way to something lighter as Cara turns back to him, her expression now more playful.
related_events: Waiter serves drinks to Frank and Cara

name: Frank and Cara's Spy Game on the Orient Express
description: Cara gestures to Frank’s well-worn spy novel and teases him about reading the genre. She leans in playfully, telling him she’s a mysterious woman on a train and challenges him to invent her story. Frank, after a moment, begins to weave a tale: she’s a diplomatic attaché, or perhaps a woman from East Germany whose father has been taken by Soviet agents. They’re blackmailing her into stealing a microchip—there’s always a microchip, he adds. Cara listens, then asks what awaits her in the story. Frank says trouble, definitely, and danger—she’ll likely be shot at within two chapters. She smiles and asks if there’s a man in her life. A pause. She repeats the question, softer, and wonders aloud if there’s even a candidate for the role. Frank looks at her, a flicker of hope in his eyes, and says, 'Maybe.'
related_events: Cara challenges Frank to invent her spy story
Frank constructs a spy narrative for Cara
Cara inquires about romance in her fictional story
Frank hesitates before suggesting a romantic possibility

name: Frank's Near Fall During Balcony Escape
description: Frank lifts himself onto the railing of his balcony, trying to reach the next one. He struggles, nearly losing his grip as he dangles over the six-story drop. A French woman nearby watches in shock, drops her coffee cup, and screams. The sound carries through the morning air, and inside the suite, the two Russian men stop their search. They rush toward the balcony, spotting Frank clinging to the stonework.
related_events: Frank attempts to cross to adjacent balcony and nearly falls
Pallid French woman drops coffee and screams upon seeing Frank

name: Russians Open Fire on Frank
description: The Russian thugs spot Frank on the balcony and immediately open fire. Bullets shatter the china on the breakfast table around him. As Frank tries to flee, he slips on spilled coffee, falls, and cuts his foot on a broken plate. He grabs his bleeding foot and curses under his breath, muttering about being a tourist caught in the middle of the violence.

Frank slips on spilled coffee while trying to escape
Frank cuts his foot on broken plate and curses his situation

name: Frank Lands on Welshman, Russians Open Fire
description: Frank heaved himself over the balcony railing and dropped onto a Burly Welshman, landing hard in his lap. The Welshman reacted instantly, punching Frank in the stomach. As Frank doubled over, two shots rang out from the adjacent balcony. The bullets struck the Welshman in the shoulder, knocking him backward. He cried out and collapsed on top of Frank, pinning him beneath his weight. The Russians stood poised on the railing, guns still raised.
related_events: Frank climbs over the railing and lands on the Burly Welshman
Burly Welshman punches Frank in the stomach
Russian thugs shoot the Burly Welshman in the shoulder

name: Frank Crawls Free and Faces a Gap Too Wide to Jump
description: Frank crawls out from under the wounded Welshman and peers over the next balcony. The roof of the adjacent building is at least twenty feet away, too far to reach. He stares at the gap, bare feet bleeding, the sound of approaching footsteps behind him.
related_events: Frank crawls out from under the wounded Welshman and peers over the next balcony
Frank realizes the next balcony is at least twenty feet from the roof

name: Demidov Receives Quinn in His Room
description: Demidov sits in his room, sipping red wine and scanning emails on his Blackberry, indifferent to the view outside. A knock at the door prompts a thick-necked bodyguard to rise and open it. He ushers in Quinn, the Swiss Interpol agent. Demidov gestures for Quinn to take a seat and offers him a glass of Brunello from 1997. When Quinn declines, Demidov swirls his wine and remarks that while he would never admit it at home, vodka is for peasants and that there is much to learn from the Italians. name: Ackerman Reveals Alexander Pearce's Criminal Past
description: Behind the ornate doors of a high-tech amphitheater, Ackerman stands at a podium before a room of European bureaucrats and officers. A fuzzy photo appears on the screen behind him—Alexander Pearce as a British schoolboy with a shy grin. Ackerman explains that Pearce showed an extraordinary talent for numbers early on, using it to hack into a school computer during his final year. He didn’t alter his own grades but changed those of all the girls in his class, drawing laughter from the room. The mood shifts as Ackerman traces Pearce’s path from that prank to more serious crimes. After a brief stint in Goldman Sachs’ training program, Pearce turned to gambling, which led him into contact with dangerous individuals. He soon began laundering money, perfecting a method known as the False Lawsuit. Using two companies—one a casino in Arizona, the other a shell in the Cayman Islands—Pearce staged lawsuits that ended in large settlements, moving illicit funds across borders and disguising them as legal payments. Jones, a U.S. representative, notes that the IRS has been defrauded of $743 million. A French Interpol officer whispers a remark about Americans, prompting a sharp, fluent reply from Jones in French that silences him. Ackerman then shows a photo of Ivan Demidov, a Russian oligarch, revealing that Pearce once laundered over a billion dollars for him before attempting to steal from him instead—an act Ackerman implies was a dangerous mistake. When asked if Pearce has ever been in custody, Ackerman pauses, then says, 'Almost.'

name: Ackerman Explains the False Lawsuit Scheme
description: Behind the ornate doors of a 17th-century building, Ackerman stands at a podium in a high-tech briefing room, addressing a room of European officials. A fuzzy photo of a young British boy appears on the screen behind him. Ackerman explains that the boy is Alexander Pearce, who once altered test scores—not his own, but those of all the girls in his class. The room chuckles, but Ackerman grows serious. He describes how Pearce left a training program at Goldman Sachs to pursue gambling, eventually turning to money laundering. He introduces the 'False Lawsuit' scheme: Pearce creates two companies—one a casino in Arizona, the other a shell company in the Cayman Islands. The shell company sues the casino, claiming copyright infringement or a similar grievance, and 'wins' a large settlement. The money moves from the U.S. to the Cayman Islands, appearing as a legal payment. Quinn, the Swiss Interpol liaison, nods, understanding—the funds are now disguised. Jones, the American representative, adds that the IRS has been cheated, and Pearce owes $743 million in unpaid taxes. Jean Luc whispers a remark in French about the American presence, but Jones responds in fluent French, silencing him. Ackerman continues, revealing that Pearce also laundered over a billion dollars for Russian oligarch Ivan Demidov—until he stole from him instead. The room absorbs the information as Ackerman pauses, then admits quietly that Pearce has never been caught—only almost.

name: Cara Remembers a Deceitful Man
description: Cara sits at the table, the bottle of Orvieto between her and Frank. She speaks of a man from her past, someone who had a way of dancing around questions so smoothly that the evasion went unnoticed until much later. She takes a sip of wine, her voice tinged with bitterness as she recalls how he lived a life built on lies, so many that she wouldn’t believe him even if he ever spoke the truth. The watch on her wrist catches the light. Frank notices it, and when he asks about it, she looks at him with a faint smile, then removes the watch and places it in his hand.
related_events: Cara recalls someone who evaded truth through eloquent deflection

name: Frank Questions the Watch
description: Cara and Frank sit together at a table with a bottle of Orvieto between them. As they talk, Frank notices the watch on Cara's wrist. He asks why she is wearing it—the watch belonging to the man she described as a liar, a man whose life was built on deception. Cara looks at him, then slowly runs her finger over the face of the watch. Without a word, she unclasps it and reaches for Frank's hand. He resists, saying it must be worth a fortune, but she insists, telling him to take it or she will throw it into the ocean. He hesitates, then closes the clasp around his own wrist. He holds his arm out, feeling its weight, studying its craftsmanship. Cara leans back in her chair, a small smile forming. Frank looks up. 'What?' he asks. 'It suits you,' she says. Behind them, the sun sets, casting a warm glow over the table. In the foreground, unnoticed by them, a well-dressed Englishman stands nearby, watching.
related_events: Frank notices and questions Cara about wearing a former lover's watch

name: Cara Gives Frank the Watch
description: Cara unclasps the watch from her wrist and places it into Frank's hand, urging him to take it. Frank resists at first, noting its value, but Cara insists, saying he's doing her a favor and threatening to throw it into the ocean if he refuses. He relents, fastening the watch onto his wrist. He holds his arm up, feeling its weight, and remarks on its beauty. Cara leans back in her chair, watching him with a quiet smile. Frank looks up and sees her expression. 'It suits you,' she says.

name: The Watcher at Sunset
description: Frank and Cara sit together at a table as the sun dips below the horizon, casting a warm glow over their quiet dinner. A bottle of Orvieto rests between them. After a conversation about love, chance, and a man from Cara's past, she removes a watch from her wrist and places it on Frank's, despite his hesitation. He fastens it, feeling its weight, and looks up at her. She smiles. The two are framed by the fading light, still and close, like lovers. In the foreground, just beyond them, a good-looking Englishman stands unnoticed, watching them in silence.

name: Cara Confronts Intruders and Locks the Bedroom Door
description: Cara Mason, wrapped in a towel, steps out of the bathroom into the master bedroom suite. She sits on the bed and begins drying her hair, placing her hand on the night table beside a set of keys, a wallet, and an expensive man's watch. Suddenly, she pauses, hearing a sound. She rises and walks across the tiled floor to the balcony overlooking the elevator entrance. There, she freezes—six tactical officers stand below, guns aimed at her. Ackerman steps forward, raising a hand and gesturing for her to stay quiet and come toward him. Without moving at first, Cara then turns and rushes back inside, slamming the heavy oaken door shut and locking it. From within the room, she calls out, 'Alexander!'

It is rushed up the stairs and used by the tactical team to crack the door open. Ackerman charges into the bedroom. name: Ackerman Finds the Escape Route
description: After breaking into the master bedroom, Ackerman notices an open window with a window washer's rigging swaying in the ocean breeze. He steps forward and looks out, spotting a water taxi pulling away from the dock in the distance. He turns toward the study and sees a desk with a steaming cup of coffee and a cigarette burning in an ashtray, smoke curling upward. Nearby, an empty chair spins slowly. Ackerman stands in silence, taking in the scene.

description: Ackerman stands before Cara Mason, who is in custody, and locks eyes with her as he demands information. She does not respond, holding his gaze for a moment before slowly lowering her eyes. Frustrated, Ackerman turns and orders her to be removed. The Tall Commander steps forward, takes hold of the handcuffed Cara, and leads her down the stairs and into the elevator. As she is escorted away, Alexander's watch is visible on her wrist.

name: Cara Approaches the French Man on the Platform
description: Cara walks along the platform as men board the Orient Express. She looks at each man carefully, then moves past them—too old, too young, too thin, too heavy. Her gaze settles on a well-dressed French man of medium height and build, standing alone and checking his ticket. Cara pauses, glancing at her reflection in the train’s glass window. She adjusts her hair and straightens her dress. Satisfied, she begins walking toward the man, moving with quiet purpose. Her heels click against the platform as she closes the distance between them.

name: Cara's Approach Interrupted by the French Man's Wife
description: Cara walks toward the well-dressed French man, her steps deliberate. He looks up, sees her, and his mouth falls open in surprise. Before she can speak, his wife appears, snaps his mouth shut with her hand, and scolds him. 'What are you doing, Vincent? Our train car is over here!' She pulls him away. He glances back at Cara with regret as he is led off. Cara remains standing alone on the platform.

name: Cara abandons the tousle-haired man after seeing his height
description: After the French man is led away by his wife, Cara scans the platform for another option. She notices a tousle-haired man sitting on a bench and begins moving toward him. As he gathers his belongings and stands, it becomes clear he is extremely tall—nearly six foot seven. Cara stops in her tracks, her expression shifting to irritation. She makes no further move toward him as he boards the train.

name: Cara Boards the Train After Colliding with Frank Taylor
description: The conductor's voice echoes across the platform: 'All aboard! All aboard the 4:25!' Passengers hurry toward the train. Frank Taylor, a cheerful American tourist, struggles with his suitcase as he steps forward. He doesn't see Cara in time and collides with her. 'Ow!' she exclaims. 'Sorry! Excuse me. Pardone moi,' Frank says, flustered, muttering more apologies as he carefully moves around her and continues up the steps into the train. Cara watches him go, her expression cool and dismissive at first. She peers over her glasses, studying him more closely—his average height, his unremarkable build. Her gaze lingers. The irritation in her face fades, replaced by something more calculating. Without hesitation, she turns and follows him onto the train.

name: Frank Confronts Officer Domenico After Being Left Waiting
description: Frank sits alone in a room, a blanket over his shoulders, a rough bandage on his head. Blood has been wiped from his wound, and he wears only boxers. After more than two hours, a cheerful police officer, Domenico, enters, laughing on his phone. Frank stands and interrupts, asking to be excused. Domenico, noticing him for the first time, asks what he is doing there. Frank explains that he was told to wait and has been sitting there for over two hours. Domenico glances around, then admits the officers probably forgot about him. Frank sinks back into his seat. Domenico sits on the edge of a desk and looks at Frank with renewed interest.

name: Domenico Questions Frank in the Waiting Room
description: Domenico, a police officer with a cheerful demeanor, walks into the room while laughing on his phone, speaking in Italian. He stops mid-conversation when he notices Frank sitting under a blanket, his head wrapped in a rough bandage. Frank stands and explains he was told to wait there, adding he’s been sitting for over two hours. Domenico glances around, realizing the others must have forgotten about him, then sits on the edge of a desk. He picks up Frank’s statement and skims it, commenting on the events described—chasing, shooting—and looking skeptically at Frank, who sits quietly in his boxers. Domenico questions whether Frank is telling the truth, half-joking that he might be crazy and still telling the truth. He asks who the attackers were and why they came after him. Frank says he doesn’t know. Domenico learns they came to the hotel room pretending to be room service. He asks if Frank had a relationship with Cara Mason, teasing him when Frank admits he met her the day before and that she brought him to the hotel. Domenico dials a phone, speaks quickly in Italian, then hangs up and says Cara Mason stayed at the hotel with her husband. He suggests she might know why the men attacked Frank. Frank agrees it’s possible. When asked for her number, Frank says she didn’t give him one. Domenico looks him over and says he needs clothes, then leaves the room.

name: Frank Convinces Domenico of the Truth
description: Domenico flips through Frank's statement, skeptical of the wild events described. He looks at Frank, sitting in his boxers with a bandaged head, and laughs lightly, clearly doubting the account. Frank insists the story is true. Domenico studies him closely, then stops smiling. His expression changes as he decides Frank isn't lying. He puts the paper down and asks who the attackers might be and why they came after him. Frank says he doesn't know. Domenico asks if they followed him from the Danieli, and Frank explains they came directly to his room, posing as room service. Domenico jokes about a romantic entanglement, but Frank denies any involvement. When Domenico mentions Cara Mason, Frank hesitates. Domenico notices and teases him, but Frank grows irritated, snapping that in America, cops catch criminals, not blame victims. Domenico chuckles, then turns serious again, asking how long Frank has known Cara. Frank says he met her the day before and didn't take her to the hotel—she took him. Domenico grins briefly, then picks up the phone, makes a call in Italian, listens, and hangs up. He tells Frank that Cara was staying with her husband. He suggests she might know why the men came after Frank. Frank agrees it's possible. Domenico asks for her number, but Frank says she didn't give him one. Looking Frank over, Domenico says he needs clothes and leaves the room.
